searchText: dumb question, but how are "NodeData" encoded (as in the "eth" network protocol, i.e. state tree nodes)? couldn't find the answer on the devp2p repo I believe they are RLP encoded the same way they are stored in the trie yup, you know that you've got the right encoding if the keccak hash of the encoded node equals the hash requested by `GetNodeData`

excerpts.author: norswap
excerpts.content:
dumb question, but how are "NodeData" encoded (as in the "eth" network protocol, i.e. state tree nodes)?
couldn't find the answer on the devp2p repo

excerpts.author: pipermerriam
excerpts.content: I believe they are RLP encoded the same way they are stored in the trie

excerpts.author: jason.carver
excerpts.content: yup, you know that you've got the right encoding if the keccak hash of the encoded node equals the hash requested by `GetNodeData`
